description: The central institution of the Church, wielding both religious and political power. A city of gold-leafed spires and white marble walls where opulence masks corruption. The seat of the tribunal that will judge Cordelia.
rules: Wolves in sheep's clothing fill positions of power. Righteousness is punished; compliance is rewarded. Trials of gilded monsters are theater: the Holy See enjoys demonstrating power over normally untouchable beings. Justice is incidental to spectacle.

details.Architecture: Gold-leafed spires, white marble walls. Beautiful corruption. Beggars chased from doorways, children scrubbing marble.
details.The Hunters: Ostensibly holy warriors, often men cast out from inner circles. Some guards view hunting as beneath them; others see it as cruel work for broken men.
details.The Trial System: Trials of gilded monsters are theater. Demonstrates power over the normally untouchable. Justice is incidental.
details.The Corruption: Men like Elijah who speak truth are exiled. Men like the Archbishop who play politics rise.
details.Elijah's Degradation: Systematic humiliation through petty summons, interrupted visits, meaningless duties. Death by a thousand cuts.
details.The Cells: Hum with holy power. Clean stone, iron bars, the weight of centuries of faith. Designed to demonstrate institutional power.
